The direct-generator construction has passed internal mathematical review, including the complete simulated output rather than just a low jump count.

I’m now checking concrete resource costs against strong alternatives. That matters more than adding another model: the current bounds are conservative, and an asymptotic improvement alone would not establish a useful breakthrough.

I’m preserving the theorem, but testing whether costs can follow the energy actually injected by the interaction rather than an overly broad whole-source bound.
